listings.title: Cats, Carats & Collectible Treasures: Lenox, Gold, Pearls & Vintage Finds
listings.description: Discover a wonderful assortment of collectible Lenox cat figurines, fine porcelain, vintage holiday décor, 14K gold and sterling silver jewelry, freshwater pearls, gemstones, and unique vintage treasures. From elegant collectibles to charming decorative pieces, this sale offers something special for collectors and treasure hunters alike!

listings.title: Scoops Auction Presents A Collection of Groovy Vintage Furniture & Decor in Philly
listings.description: Scoops Auction is back with an online vintage auction - pickup in Philadelphia, PA 19128. Don't miss a sale - please follow us @ScoopsAuction!! SHIPPING IS AVAILABLE ON MANY ITEMS. This auction is conducted by David Cody [AU006442], a licensed auctioneer in Pennsylvania. Feel free to contact Dave (dave@scoopsauction.com or 215-259-8578) with any questions *before* lots begin to close. Browse the catalog to find these amazing pieces: Furniture : Lane Acclaim, Lane Perception, Danish Teak, Stow & Davis, Velvet Mirror Tables, Overman Attr Pod Chairs, Lucite Chairs & Bar Cart, MCM Teak Tables, Cane Back Wood Chairs, Mid Century Slat Bench, GE/Telechron Clocks, 10x6 RYA Area Rug Smalls/Collectibles: Alabaster Bird Baths, Holt Howard Salt and Pepper Shakers, Brass Figurines, Georges Briard and Vintage Barware, Federal and Viking Glass, Street Signs, Telechron and Forrestville Clocks, Dansk and Littala Tealights, Miniature Medicine Bottles, California Pottery, KISS & Grateful Dead Belt Buckles, Vintage Bangles, Table/Barware from Dansk, Arrowhead, Heller, Ingrid, Tupperware, Corning Art/Wall Decor: Peter Max Posters, Stan Winston Character Drawing, Prints After Picasso & Haring, Romero Britto, Jeff Low, The Beatles Yellow Submarine Poster, Framed Embroidery, Ceramic Statues. listings.title: The Estate of Sydney & Sharon Martin: Part II
listings.description: The second installment of Pride of Place: Works from the Estate of Sydney F. and Sharon B. Martin offers a focused look at Pennsylvania Impressionism, from the villages and farms of Bucks County to the New England coastline. The sale is anchored by Edward Redfield's Spring Veil (c. 1928) and two of his snowbound winter scenes, Winter in New Hope and Winter on the Farm (Farbotnik Farm), alongside Daniel Garber's Stockton and The Studio, both from the early 1920s. George William Sotter appears in depth, with Mill-Spring Valley among the highlights, while Walter Emerson Baum's village views, including Quakertown Street and Sledding in Winter, capture the charm of the region's small towns. Coastal subjects by John Folinsbee and Walter Elmer Schofield offer a counterpoint to landscapes by William Langson Lathrop, Harry Leith-Ross, and Kenneth Nunamaker, joined by Mary Elizabeth Price's Still Life with Lillies and Foxgloves.
